label: Decide with AI
description: An AI model reads the data and picks one of the paths you describe, saying how sure it is and why. Like “Choose a path”, for decisions a rule cannot make: what a ticket is about, whether a reply is polite enough to send.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The AI model that decides. Plug in an “AI model” block.

prompt.title: What to decide
prompt.description: The question and the data it is about, e.g. Which team should handle this ticket? {{ state.ticket }}

cases.title: Choices

route.title: Path name
route.description: A short name in lowercase, e.g. billing. It appears as an output on the block.

description.title: When to choose it
description.description: What the AI reads to choose this path, e.g. questions about invoices and payments.

cases.description: The paths the AI may choose, each with when to choose it.

default.title: Path when unsure
default.description: Taken when the AI's answer is not one of the choices, or it is less sure than the minimum below.

min_confidence.title: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: Below this (0 to 1), the default path is taken. Leave empty to always follow the AI's choice.

output.title: Save the decision in
output.description: The data field that receives {choice, confidence, reason}, for later steps, traces and evaluators.
